single.text:
ASSESSMENT OVERVIEW: Tenant's annual non-rent repair exposure is capped at $2,000 for routine HVAC maintenance, well below the $3,000 annual limit. The only potential capital replacement risk involves the 19-year-old rooftop Trane unit, which exceeds its 15-18 year typical service life and would require $26,500 replacement. Since Clause 7c specifies Landlord handles 'any structural or HVAC capital unit replacement,' this cost remains Landlord's responsibility and does not shift >$3,000 capital risk to Tenant, satisfying all constraints. Key facts: Tenant's HVAC obligation capped at $2,000 aggregate per lease year; Landlord responsible for HVAC capital unit replacement per Clause 7c; Rooftop Trane unit at 19 years (exceeding 15-18 year service life) with $26,500 replacement cost.
POINTS OF NOTE: No concrete constraint violations flagged.
SUGGESTED NEXT STEP: None required; stated constraints appear satisfied.
